items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, what kind of stuff did he play, James Willigan? [INTERVIEWEE] He was a drummer. He used to use plenty of roles. Like I said, the same, almost the same beats like Red Happy, James.

ctx.x: Well, what kind of stuff did he play, James Willigan?

He was a drummer. He used to use plenty of roles. Like I said, the same, almost the same beats like Red Happy, James. Yeah. Want me to make some of them beats he makes? Yeah, sure. Yeah, beats he had to beat something like this.
Oh, yeah. Hey, would he use that on every tune, like Red Happy would use it?
